Subject: Quickplay: 20–30 min to review your recent usage spike

Hi Sam —

Noticed Brightline crossed a 50k token/day threshold this morning from your self-serve project (awesome!). I wanted to offer a focused 20–30 minute Quickplay session to:

- review the usage pattern we saw (prefixes, longest sequences)
- show a few lightweight tuning options to cut token cost 20–40%
- answer any integration questions your engineers have

Would any of these windows work for you?
- Thu 4/26 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 4/26 15:00–15:30 PT
- Fri 4/27 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, reply with two times that do and I’ll loop in Ben (AE) for commercial questions and Olga (CS) for any infra/latency topics. I attached a quick usage snapshot so you don’t have to dig it up.

Thanks — excited to help you get more out of the trial.

—
Sergio Alvarez
SDR, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
